reason: The pressure patch kit is the obvious tool for sealing the torn habitat wall before refilling it.
expectation: The kit should seal the puncture, leaving the habitat ready to be refilled.

alternatives.reason: Stabilizing the lander is also necessary, but the habitat seal directly addresses the current goal.

effect: The puncture is sealed, so the habitat can now be refilled.
reaction: The backing plate makes the repair feel concrete.
reason: The sealed wall and breathing-gas supply suggest refilling the habitat now.
expectation: The gas supply should refill the sealed habitat.

alternatives.reason: Stabilizing the lander is also needed for access to supplies.

effect: The habitat is breathable, and the next goal is to make the lander safe to board.
reaction: The regulator and gauge make the refill feel grounded.
reason: Shipping braces appear suited to stabilizing the damaged landing support.
expectation: The braces should stabilize the lander, possibly with help from the tool kit.

effect: The braces needed cutting into steel before they could be used; I can now try the prepared material on the support.
reaction: The preparation step makes physical sense, though I had expected the braces to fit directly.
reason: The prepared steel lengths and sheet may reinforce the unstable landing support.
expectation: The steel should help stabilize the lander, possibly using the tool kit.

effect: The steel became a load-spreading crib, stabilizing the lander and completing the chapter’s goals.
reaction: The explanation of the wide base and inspection points made the repair feel satisfying and physically grounded.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the cribbed platform was most worthwhile: the result explained how it supports the load and makes boarding safer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the shipping braces was a small detour: I expected to use them directly, although cutting them into usable steel made sense afterward.

surprise.text: The braces had to be cut into steel first rather than fitted directly to the support.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; even the unexpected brace preparation had a clear physical purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the expedition develops; the grounded repair details made the opening engaging.
